body:
Measured in the 2026-09-20 long-session benchmark: session state on disk grows ~39 KB per turn, and 97% of it is SQLite WAL churn. Every message is appended to `transcript.jsonl` (599 B per turn) AND posted into the sqlite store (`agent.go:2381-2386` via chatlog.go), which dirties ~32 WAL frames (135 KB) per turn until the ~4 MB WAL ceiling at turn ~22, one 496 KB checkpoint, then a steady 2.8 KB per turn. The model reconciles with measured `du` deltas to within 0.01%.

Bounded (self-limits at the ceiling), so not urgent, but the double write is doing work nobody measured a need for. Candidates: batch the store write, checkpoint earlier, or pick a single journal.

—
